purpose: Define bounded runtime injection of secret material into exact operation/backend/process contexts without persisting values into normal configuration, traces or outputs.

topics.name: Secret Runtime Injection
topics.purpose: Define bounded runtime injection of secret material into exact operation/backend/process contexts without persisting values into normal configuration, traces or outputs.

semantics.target_rule: Injection targets an exact runtime component/execution/backend identity.
semantics.lifetime_rule: Secret material lifetime is bounded to the declared operation/session/profile.
semantics.storage_rule: Injected value is not written back to canonical configuration.
semantics.logging_rule: Injected values are redacted from logs/traces/errors.
semantics.inheritance_rule: Child process/component inheritance is explicit and minimal.
semantics.cleanup_rule: Material is released/zeroized where supported after scope ends.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant definitions, executions, evidence and runtime state use explicit identities and boundaries; visibility, file order, timestamps, transport reachability or UI placement never silently create semantic authority.
